about: The board on the twelve held-out cases on release 1.1.1's code, three runs a case, board mode: all four members on claude-opus-5-5, then the three specialists on claude-sonnet-5-5 with the coordinator on claude-opus-5-5. Graded by tests/fair_test/grade.py, unchanged, then re-graded blind. Categories: R right, D defensible, N+ needless stop well aimed, N- needless stop blind, F false closure, Wp wrong write proposed, Wx wrong write executed. Lower mean loss is better. The page: docs/readme/fair-test.md#release-11x.
played_on: an AI Hub 109 instance (IRIS for Health Community 2027.1.0AI.109.0 with AI Hub), 8 November 2026: release 1.1.0's code with release 1.1.1's model view (src/Shutter/Util/ModelView.cls) loaded over it, which is 1.1.1's source under the 1.1.0 version string. The all-Opus board from 13:01 to 13:35 UTC, the mixed board from 13:38 to 14:06 UTC, one after the other. The sealed manifest checked OK before and after each board.
method: tests/fair_test/play.py and grade.py from release 1.1.0, seed 20261106, --day 2026-11-05, 600 s timeout, approval by the rig, three runs a case, the case order of the 1.0.0 runs; no run was unscorable, retried or stopped early.

settled.rule: F03 settled as R: scoring.md scores the disposition the mode settled on before the dispatch gate, which was reconcile, the reference, and nothing was written. The grader gives N+ because the case ended blocked for a person. The blind re-grade of these 72 runs agrees with the grader on 66 and gives R on the six F03 runs.

gate_stops.F03: RECEIPT_PAYLOAD_DIFFERS at proposal: the receipt's bed is JSON null and reads as a different bed. A bug; nothing was written.
gate_stops.F07: FURTHER_MOVEMENT at proposal: a discharge on another visit beside the transfer. The shipped default (further_messages.in_patient_movement: stop); nothing was written.

compared_with: release 1.0.0's board on the same cases (results.json, modes.board): 30 R, 6 D, strict 0.167, lenient 0.000.
